title: Chief Justice Of India Surya Kant Launches Prof. (Dr.) Seema Gupta's Book 'The Mediation Movement In India' At Chandigarh
description: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on July 18, 2026 released the book 'The Mediation Movement in India' at Chandigarh. The book examines mediation and its growth in India, with a particular focus on the Mediation Act, 2023. The book has been edited by Prof. (Dr.) Seema Gupta, Professor in Law at the University Institute of Legal Studies (UILS), Chandigarh University.
